## Welcome to Active Care Center

#### About us

We have been treating patients with musculoskeletal injuries and ailments since 2002. We pride
ourselves on our approach to diagnosis and treatment. Reaching the correct diagnosis is paramount in
each case as it determines the appropriate course of treatment. Whether an advanced in-clinic
orthopedic examination, in-house NCV/EMG nerve study, or further referral for MRI evaluation is in
order, no patient treatment starts before we are sure of what we are treating.  



To treat your pain, we may utilize standard chiropractic manipulative medicine, advanced MLS Laser
Therapy, nutritional counseling, or acupuncture; in many cases, physical therapy exercises, manual
therapy, or a strengthening program may be necessary. The combinations and approaches are many, but
the goal is only one – to get you back to optimum health.



We also offer unique services to the Transportation Industry; our clinic is certified by the FMCSA
to perform DOT Medical Testing, drug testing, and random alcohol testing.  We work with various
Transport and Logistics companies as well as Truck Driving Schools. 

## Conditions Treated

#### Additional Information

 Active Care Center specializes in the treatment of musculoskeletal problems.  Our care also
encompasses management of various non-injury related chronic illnesses.
* Back pain
* Neck pain
* Arm and Leg pain and tingling
* Headaches (migraine, tension, cervicogenic)
* Sports injuries
* Arthritis and Tendinitis
* Sciatica and Brachialgia
* Bulging and herniated disks
* Sprains and strains
* Automobile crash and Whiplash injuries
* Post-surgical rehabilitation
* Scoliosis
* Plantar fasciitis and heel pain
* Knee and Hip osteoarthritis
* Muscle pain
* Carpal tunnel syndrome and other neuropathies

#### Chiropractic Medicine

Using safe and gentle joint manipulation, we can decrease pain, increase the range of motion, and
improve the functioning of the neck, back, and extremities.  In conjunction with knowledge of modern
medicine, orthopedics, neurology, and internal medicine, Chiropractors can non-invasively relieve
pain and return the patient to full health, unlike any other medical specialty. We are particularly
proud of our high success rate in the treatment of back and neck pain.

#### Non-invasive Orthopedics

Our clinic’s focus on the diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal ailments stems from our
clinical director’s passion and great interest in chiropractic orthopedics, physical therapy, and
rehabilitation. 

 Dr. Albert Pawlusiewicz is a Board Certified Chiropractic Orthopedist, who has dedicated his career
to non-invasive treatment of orthopedic, sports, and post-trauma injuries.  Orthopedics does not
have to mean surgery; in fact, over 99% of all orthopedic cases we see are never treated surgically.

## Welcome to Active Care Center

#### About us

We have been treating patients with musculoskeletal injuries and ailments since 2002. We pride
ourselves on our approach to diagnosis and treatment. Reaching the correct diagnosis is paramount in
each case as it determines the appropriate course of treatment. Whether an advanced in-clinic
orthopedic examination, in-house NCV/EMG nerve study, or further referral for MRI evaluation is in
order, no patient treatment starts before we are sure of what we are treating.  



To treat your pain, we may utilize standard chiropractic manipulative medicine, advanced MLS Laser
Therapy, nutritional counseling, or acupuncture; in many cases, physical therapy exercises, manual
therapy, or a strengthening program may be necessary. The combinations and approaches are many, but
the goal is only one – to get you back to optimum health.



We also offer unique services to the Transportation Industry; our clinic is certified by the FMCSA
to perform DOT Medical Testing, drug testing, and random alcohol testing.  We work with various
Transport and Logistics companies as well as Truck Driving Schools.

## Medical Services

#### Chiropractic Medicine

Using safe and gentle joint manipulation, we can decrease pain, increase the range of motion, and
improve the functioning of the neck, back, and extremities.  In conjunction with knowledge of modern
medicine, orthopedics, neurology, and internal medicine, Chiropractors can non-invasively relieve
pain and return the patient to full health, unlike any other medical specialty. We are particularly
proud of our high success rate in the treatment of back and neck pain.

#### Non-invasive Orthopedics

Our clinic’s focus on the diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal ailments stems from our
clinical director’s passion and great interest in chiropractic orthopedics, physical therapy, and
rehabilitation. 

 Dr. Albert Pawlusiewicz is a Board Certified Chiropractic Orthopedist, who has dedicated his career
to non-invasive treatment of orthopedic, sports, and post-trauma injuries.  Orthopedics does not
have to mean surgery; in fact, over 99% of all orthopedic cases we see are never treated surgically.
 

#### Physical Therapy

At Active Care Center, the paramount focus is centered on "*functional* *rehabilitation"* of our
patients.  This means that the therapists not only focus on improvements in range of motion or
strength itself but primarily look at how these improvements translate to the ability to perform all
home, leisure, and work tasks.  It is imperative to know how the injury affects the patient's daily
activities and set therapy goals accordingly to restore his or her ability to perform these tasks
after therapy.

#### Acupuncture

Acupuncture is used at our clinic as an adjunct therapy method in treating painful conditions,
especially those that incapacitate the patient to such an extent that physical therapy and manual
therapy cannot be initially utilized.  We also use needling in difficult or therapy-resistant
conditions such as frozen shoulder or sciatica.  The decision to use acupuncture is made on a case
by case basis and depends on the ailment, its chronicity, and best medical practice.

#### Injury Management

At Active Care Center the injured person, be it from a car, work, or other injury, will find a
dedicated team of providers who will objectively evaluate the injury, make specific recommendations,
and initiate treatment of the injury. Additionally, we help our patients to file a claim with a
responsible party as many patients are too emotionally distraught or do not know how to deal with
the insurance situation, and what steps to take to get their health back without worrying about
finances.

#### Post-surgical rehabilitation

For many illnesses and injuries, surgery is often a necessary solution.  Post-surgical
rehabilitation is a key factor in successful recovery. Physical therapy can aid the healing process
through reduction of initial swelling, improving range of motion, and regaining of strength,  The
end goal is to return the patient to full and pain-free daily home and work activities. Our Physical
Therapists follow strict guidelines and protocols to ensure gradual improvement without risking
injuring the delicate, healing tissue.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine in the Gold Coast neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois is
a practice providing their patients with exceptional integrative and holistic women’s health care.
Doctors Hoyer and Skul met in medical school and have practiced together ever since. After
practicing academic medicine at Rush University Medical Center since the mid-80's, they opened their
medical practice – Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine in 2001. Committed to each other
and the common goal of patient-centered care, they designed a healthcare environment different from
the customary doctor’s office.

At Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine, the team understands that seeing the doctor is only
one part of your medical experience. They have a dedicated, highly trained, knowledgeable and
friendly staff to help them provide a warm, family-like atmosphere for their patients.

The Center’s expertise is in primary women’s health care. The physicians are board-certified in
Internal Medicine and Anti-Aging and Regenerative Medicine. They espouse a philosophy of
patient-centered care, approaching each patient compassionately and supporting them through their
health journey. They emphasize preventive care, patient education and lifestyle change and partner
with their patients to facilitate the best medical decision making. This ultimately leads to optimum
outcomes.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine also serves the needs of male patients, often referred by
their mothers, sisters and significant others. Patients come from a variety of ethnic backgrounds,
span ages from adolescence to senescence and often include several generations of the same family.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine doctors have been recognized as Chicago’s and America’s
Top Doctors year after year. Dr. Skul and Dr. Hoyer have been among the "Best Doctors for Women in
Chicago," “Top Primary Care Doctors in Chicago,” and "Top Doctors in Chicago" as reported by Chicago
Magazine. They also continue to be named "The Nation's Top Doctors" by US News. They were also
ranked as Chicago Super Doctors, won the Super Service Award for Internal Medicine from Angie's
List, and have been selected as Castle Connolly's Exceptional Women in Medicine for 2019.

Call or book an appointment online with Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine today.

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.

cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

useful information, honest guidance, and practical support that make everyday life a little easier
to manage.

From helpful educational content to hands-on senior wellness support in Montclair, NJ, the goal is
simple. To help seniors live with more comfort, more confidence, and more independence.

## Our Wellness Services for Seniors

HealthySeventy looks at the full aging journey, not just one piece of it. Here is what we offer in
our health and wellness programs for aging adults:

HealthySeventy offers a senior wellness program in Montclair, NJ, designed to support the full aging
journey. Instead of focusing on a single aspect of senior health, we examine the habits and tools
that shape their everyday well-being.

We offer a comprehensive suite of therapies designed to work in harmony, reducing inflammation and
restoring proper movement patterns for long-term health.

### Chiropractic Care

Optimal spinal function supports a more adaptable, efficient nervous system. By restoring proper
joint motion and reducing mechanical stress, we help your brain and body communicate more
effectively—allowing you to move better, recover faster, and function at your highest level.

### Class IV Laser Therapy

Experience advanced, non-invasive treatment designed to accelerate healing and reduce pain at the
cellular level. Our Aspen Class IV Laser increases circulation, decreases inflammation, and
stimulates tissue repair—helping you recover faster and get back to doing what you love.


### Massage Therapy

Our licensed therapists provide customized soft tissue care that complements chiropractic
adjustments, decreasing muscle tension and improving mobility.

## Raise your hand if the process of or shopping for home medical equipment makes you feel like

## ***Decision fatigue***

## ***A sense of obligation***

[Contact Us][17]

# **HOME CARE EQUIPMENT** *Experts at your service*

What if you could work with a home-grown company that has your loved ones’ best interests at heart?
Our goal – no matter what – is to make sure you walk away with the peace of mind that comes from
knowing you’ve purchased the best possible product to keep them happy, healthy, and safe.

## **Visit our showrooms**

It’s hard to shop online when you don’t know exactly what you’re looking for. We invite you to visit
one of our three showrooms to explore the possibilities!

## **Cut to the chase**

Our super-savvy team members can help you figure out the equipment that best meets your needs.
(Exhale. Frustrating Google searches are a thing of the past!)

## Feel good about your decision

You’ll feel a huge sense of relief when you buy the right equipment with confidence. (Knowing that
you’ve found the perfect way to protect and care for your loved one is priceless.)

# Walk out the door knowing you got it right

With two showrooms in Fort Wayne and one in Auburn, we invite you to stop in to see – or try! –
anything we have in stock. We’ll help you figure out the best solutions for your loved one,
providing the kind of honest insight and helpful tips you’d get from a lifelong friend.

# Expert service meets quality products

## Living with short- or long-term physical limitations can be tough – but the right home medical
## equipment can go a long way toward maintaining safety and comfort.

[View Services][19]

Safely transition from sleeping, sitting, and standing positions with the help of motorized lift
chairs.

Easily navigate stairs with motoriized lift chairs that operate using a mounted rail.

## **Wheelchairs**

Maintain independence, safety and comfort with our selection of manual and power wheelchairs.

Improve circulation, reduce swelling, and decrease the likelihood of venous disorders.

# Here's How It Works...

## **Speak With An Expert**

Stop by one of our two locations (or give us a call!) to chat with someone about your specific
needs. We’ll gladly point you toward the equipment that best meets your needs..

## **Choose The Right Product**

We’ll walk you through the pros and cons of the items you’re considering, giving you straightforward
information to guide your buying decision. (No pressure … the decision is yours!)

## **Enjoy Delivery + Professional Setup**

(Frustrating) assembly NOT required! We’ll deliver the product you’ve chosen, often as soon as the
same day! We’ll help you set it up, and we’ll make sure you know exactly how to use it.

## **Get Follow-up Support + Service**

Having trouble with your equipment? We’ll fix it, and we’ll give you loaner equipment while your
product is here for repair. We also offer 24-hour on-call emergency service.

At James Medical, we know you care deeply about your parent, grandparent, or loved one, and you’re
committed to serving them in the best way you know how.

You need to partner with someone who understands your struggles and can provide straightforward and
honest input, ultimately allowing you to feel confident in your decisions.

Ultimately, taking care of aging parents and grandparents shouldn’t be so hard. We’ve been serving
Fort Wayne families for nearly 50 years, and we look forward to continuing that tradition for years
to come.

We're a specialist MedTech contract research organisation (CRO) with clinical trial expertise across
Australia, New Zealand, and the USA. We help innovators move from the bench to the market with

## Advancing world-first breakthroughs, faster

World first breakthroughs aren't designed to sit on the lab bench forever. They need to be in the
hands of doctors and patients - saving lives and transforming outcomes. We help you get there.

### Tailored services

Clinical and regulatory strategies that adapt to your pathway

### Full-service model

Clinician-led expertise plus strategic partners, from pre-clinical to post-market.

### Global standards

Compliance with FDA, EMA, TGA, and other regulatory bodies

## The Mobius difference

Medical innovations are not one-size-fits-all, so why should your clinical trials be? At Mobius, our
team uses their deep expertise to develop a clinical trial strategy tailored for you.

### Traditional CRO

Rigid processes
Highly structured with little room for change
Personalized approach
Projects are tailor-made for your needs with room to pivot
Just another client
Revolving door of project managers who don't offer any personalization
Engaged, responsive team
Founders and project managers who embed into your team and champion your goals
Generalised MedTech Knowledge
Expertise may be lacking in medical device trials.
Deep, niche expertise
Medical device experts from trial design to data management

## Managed 140+ clinical trial projects

Mobius helps turn your innovation into standard care

CASE STUDY

### Revolutionising sperm selection with safer, stress-free technology

A new electrophoretic system offered a faster, safer alternative to conventional sperm selection. In
a multicentre pivotal trial, it outperformed Density Gradient Centrifugation, matched Swim-Up, and
showed no adverse events-supporting CE Mark submission.

[Read case study ->][19]
This is some text inside of a div block.
CASE STUDY

### Early feasibility to global pivotal trial for mitral valve innovation

An innovative repositionable mitral valve system underwent early feasibility trials in Australia
before scaling to a global pivotal study. Results showed durable valve function, improved survival,
and quality of life-culminating in CE Mark (2020) and FDA approval (2025).

[Read case study ->][20]
This is some text inside of a div block.
CASE STUDY

### Validating a non-invasive pain relief device for pregnancy

Pregnant women in their third trimester experienced better sleep and less pain using a specialised
maternity airbed tested in a Mobius-run pilot trial. The study validated safety, comfort, and
efficacy-proving a non-invasive way to ease late-pregnancy discomfort.

[Read case study ->][21]
This is some text inside of a div block.
"Mobius Medical have been a pleasure to work with. Their staff are reliable, they have solutions for
nearly every query and have a range of experience being able to support from conception through to
closeout."
"A great example of the new style of CROs - responsive, easy to work with, cost-effective,
collaborative and comprehensive in all their service offerings. We could not have chosen a better
partner for our investigative sites."
"The single most crucial attribute that Mobius Medical provides is their personnel. They have
staffed an incredibly skilful, competent and reliable team which is second to none. Enabling them to
execute exceptionally well as an organization."

## Global credibility, local *mastery*.

Clinical trials need to be built to scale. Our expertise ensures faster timelines, cost-effective
options, and data accepted by local regulators. whether scaling early studies from Australia to the
world, doing a pivotal study in the US or something in between - we transform your outcomes ensuring
success.
[About Mobius ->][22]

## Go from clinical trials to the market with us

Our ecosystem of partners extends your reach beyond clinical trials.

The NextGen Abs Stimulator works by sending electrical impulses to your abdominal muscles, causing

## **Scientific Basis of EMS**

EMS works by sending electrical impulses to muscles to induce contractions, mimicking the
contractions that occur during voluntary muscle actions like exercise. This technology has been used
in medical rehabilitation and physical therapy for muscle recovery and to prevent muscle atrophy in
patients who are unable to exercise.

EMS can help increase muscle strength and tone when used consistently over time. A study found that
using an EMS device can lead to improvements in abdominal muscle strength and endurance.

The Pain Relief Clinic is a medical practice that combines traditional pain management techniques
with non-invasive treatment technologies available, to specifically help patients who suffer from
both acute and persistent pain.

Using a combination of conventional medicine, as well as new technologies such as INDIBA® activ
ProRecovery and Shockwave Therapy, we provide effective clinical solutions to pain.

drug free options, that are effective for patients who still suffer from pain after trying other
treatments, or who are not comfortable with the risks and complications of other options.

## The Importance of Treating Pain Effectively:

Acute pain from recent injuries and other diseases can result in time off work, difficulty with
participation in sports, and interfere with other normal day activities.
Persistent pain from chronic injuries, wear and tear, nerve pain, and other causes often results in
frustration, low energy level, poor sleep (insomnia), irritability, depressed mood, difficulty with
concentration and memory, mobility problems and even reduced sexual function.
Relationships with friends and family, work, personal happiness and life in general may also be
affected. Pain has even been associated with loss of brain mass.

By properly treating persistent pain, patients will be able to enjoy work, sports, and life in
general more effectively.
Sleep will also become more restful, resulting in more energetic days and better moods.

### Georgia’s Most Trusted Rehabilitation & Back Pain Specialists

## Welcome to Southern Pain and Spine

Pain is personal. Our goal is to understand your pain and develop a customized treatment plan to
relieve your pain and get you back to the life you love.

Our board certified physicians and advanced practice providers take a comprehensive and
rehabilitative approach to pain and offer a wide range of interventional and minimally invasive
surgical treatments to heal chronic pain. 

At Southern Pain and Spine, we are pleased to bring a premier level of minimally-invasive spine and
joint pain care to metro Atlanta, North Georgia, and beyond. If you’re ready to take the first step
toward reducing pain and improving function, we’re here to help.

## Multidisciplinary care for people living with chronic pain

At the Pain Collective, we provide multidisciplinary pain management services through a network of
clinics across South Africa.

Our interdisciplinary team of doctors and therapists utilises therapy, medication, patient-centred
modalities, and interventional procedures as part of pain management.

Our approach emphasises active, patient -centred care and interventional strategies where
appropriate.

As part of our commitment to transparency and ongoing quality improvement, we routinely collect
anonymous patient experience feedback and publish summary results from our monthly internal service
evaluation surveys.

**97%*** of patients who completed our anonymous monthly patient experience surveys reported being
satisfied with their overall experience at our clinics.

**92%*** of patients who completed our anonymous patient experience surveys after a theatre
procedure reported that the procedure met their expectations.

**91%*** of patients who completed our anonymous patient experience surveys reported that they felt
the service represented good value for money.

**85%*** of patients reported that their doctor listened to them attentively, and 81% reported that
their doctor explained information in a way they could understand, based on responses to our
anonymous patient experience surveys.

**88%*** of patients who attended therapy services reported that the care they received from the
therapist was excellent, based on responses to our anonymous patient experience surveys.

These figures are based on routine, anonymous monthly patient experience surveys conducted for
internal service evaluation and quality improvement. Survey responses reflect patient-reported
experiences of care, communication, and service delivery. These data are not intended to represent
clinical outcomes, treatment efficacy, or guarantees of results.

## ABOUT US

The Pain Collective is a group of doctors and therapists who share a passion for conservative and
holistic pain management. We treat a range of conditions, including back, neck, knee, and hip pain,
as well as chronic headaches and many other similar conditions. Our aim is to diagnose and treat
pain – without surgery – through the use of an interdisciplinary team and maintenance programmes.

Most post-op TrueRelief protocols call for three 12-minute treatments in the first 48 hours after
surgery. Treatments are nurse or technician administered and non-sterile.

“We treat the operative areas immediately after surgery and then for two days post-op. We found that
patients who would normally require narcotics, now need zero prescription medication at all. I
simply treat my surgical patients with TrueRelief and acetaminophen.

“I might add that I have been on the receiving end of the device. Following my own back surgery, I
required no prescription medications post-operatively.”

## What can you expect with clinical treatments for acute and chronic pain?

Typical treatments in a clinical setting range from 10-20 minutes for most acute injuries or
conditions, or 15-25 minutes for more complex chronic conditions.

The number of treatments required varies by condition. Some patients require as few as 1-4
treatments, while others (usually with long standing chronic pain) may require 4-8 treatments.

TrueRelief treatments have a cumulative effect so treatments should generally not be spaced more
than every third day and usually every other day is optimal. In some acute cases and some
post-surgical cases, initial treatments may be called for every day.

## What can you expect with clinical treatments for acute and chronic pain?

Typical treatments in a clinical setting range from 10-20 minutes for most acute injuries or
conditions, or 15-25 minutes for more complex chronic conditions.

The number of treatments required varies by condition. Some patients require as few as 1-4
treatments, while others (usually with long standing chronic pain) may require 4-8 treatments.

TrueRelief treatments have a cumulative effect so treatments should generally not be spaced more
than every third day and usually every other day is optimal. In some acute cases and some
post-surgical cases, initial treatments may be called for every day.

* Gave 189 TrueRelief treatments to 54 patients (an average of 3.5 treatments per patient).

* After the full course of their treatments (which ranged from one treatment to eleven, varying by
  patient and condition), 74% of all patients achieved total elimination of their pain.

the management of post-surgical and post-traumatic acute pain. It is intended for use under the
supervision of a Healthcare Professional. TrueRelief should not be used on patients who are pregnant
or have a cardiac demand pacemaker. For a complete listing of the Indication for Use and all

## Welcome to Active Care Center

#### About us

We have been treating patients with musculoskeletal injuries and ailments since 2002. We pride
ourselves on our approach to diagnosis and treatment. Reaching the correct diagnosis is paramount in
each case as it determines the appropriate course of treatment. Whether an advanced in-clinic
orthopedic examination, in-house NCV/EMG nerve study, or further referral for MRI evaluation is in
order, no patient treatment starts before we are sure of what we are treating.  



To treat your pain, we may utilize standard chiropractic manipulative medicine, advanced MLS Laser
Therapy, nutritional counseling, or acupuncture; in many cases, physical therapy exercises, manual
therapy, or a strengthening program may be necessary. The combinations and approaches are many, but
the goal is only one – to get you back to optimum health.



We also offer unique services to the Transportation Industry; our clinic is certified by the FMCSA
to perform DOT Medical Testing, drug testing, and random alcohol testing.  We work with various
Transport and Logistics companies as well as Truck Driving Schools. 

## Conditions Treated

#### Additional Information

 Active Care Center specializes in the treatment of musculoskeletal problems.  Our care also
encompasses management of various non-injury related chronic illnesses.
* Back pain
* Neck pain
* Arm and Leg pain and tingling
* Headaches (migraine, tension, cervicogenic)
* Sports injuries
* Arthritis and Tendinitis
* Sciatica and Brachialgia
* Bulging and herniated disks
* Sprains and strains
* Automobile crash and Whiplash injuries
* Post-surgical rehabilitation
* Scoliosis
* Plantar fasciitis and heel pain
* Knee and Hip osteoarthritis
* Muscle pain
* Carpal tunnel syndrome and other neuropathies

#### Chiropractic Medicine

Using safe and gentle joint manipulation, we can decrease pain, increase the range of motion, and
improve the functioning of the neck, back, and extremities.  In conjunction with knowledge of modern
medicine, orthopedics, neurology, and internal medicine, Chiropractors can non-invasively relieve
pain and return the patient to full health, unlike any other medical specialty. We are particularly
proud of our high success rate in the treatment of back and neck pain.

#### Non-invasive Orthopedics

Our clinic’s focus on the diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal ailments stems from our
clinical director’s passion and great interest in chiropractic orthopedics, physical therapy, and
rehabilitation. 

 Dr. Albert Pawlusiewicz is a Board Certified Chiropractic Orthopedist, who has dedicated his career
to non-invasive treatment of orthopedic, sports, and post-trauma injuries.  Orthopedics does not
have to mean surgery; in fact, over 99% of all orthopedic cases we see are never treated surgically.
 

#### Physical Therapy

At Active Care Center, the paramount focus is centered on "*functional* *rehabilitation"* of our
patients.  This means that the therapists not only focus on improvements in range of motion or
strength itself but primarily look at how these improvements translate to the ability to perform all
home, leisure, and work tasks.  It is imperative to know how the injury affects the patient's daily
activities and set therapy goals accordingly to restore his or her ability to perform these tasks
after therapy.

#### Acupuncture

Acupuncture is used at our clinic as an adjunct therapy method in treating painful conditions,
especially those that incapacitate the patient to such an extent that physical therapy and manual
therapy cannot be initially utilized.  We also use needling in difficult or therapy-resistant
conditions such as frozen shoulder or sciatica.  The decision to use acupuncture is made on a case
by case basis and depends on the ailment, its chronicity, and best medical practice.

#### Injury Management

At Active Care Center the injured person, be it from a car, work, or other injury, will find a
dedicated team of providers who will objectively evaluate the injury, make specific recommendations,
and initiate treatment of the injury. Additionally, we help our patients to file a claim with a
responsible party as many patients are too emotionally distraught or do not know how to deal with
the insurance situation, and what steps to take to get their health back without worrying about
finances.

#### Post-surgical rehabilitation

For many illnesses and injuries, surgery is often a necessary solution.  Post-surgical
rehabilitation is a key factor in successful recovery. Physical therapy can aid the healing process
through reduction of initial swelling, improving range of motion, and regaining of strength,  The
end goal is to return the patient to full and pain-free daily home and work activities. Our Physical
Therapists follow strict guidelines and protocols to ensure gradual improvement without risking
injuring the delicate, healing tissue.

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine in the Gold Coast neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois is
a practice providing their patients with exceptional integrative and holistic women’s health care.
Doctors Hoyer and Skul met in medical school and have practiced together ever since. After
practicing academic medicine at Rush University Medical Center since the mid-80's, they opened their
medical practice – Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine in 2001. Committed to each other
and the common goal of patient-centered care, they designed a healthcare environment different from
the customary doctor’s office.

At Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine, the team understands that seeing the doctor is only
one part of your medical experience. They have a dedicated, highly trained, knowledgeable and
friendly staff to help them provide a warm, family-like atmosphere for their patients.

The Center’s expertise is in primary women’s health care. The physicians are board-certified in
Internal Medicine and Anti-Aging and Regenerative Medicine. They espouse a philosophy of
patient-centered care, approaching each patient compassionately and supporting them through their
health journey. They emphasize preventive care, patient education and lifestyle change and partner
with their patients to facilitate the best medical decision making. This ultimately leads to optimum
outcomes.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine also serves the needs of male patients, often referred by
their mothers, sisters and significant others. Patients come from a variety of ethnic backgrounds,
span ages from adolescence to senescence and often include several generations of the same family.

Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine doctors have been recognized as Chicago’s and America’s
Top Doctors year after year. Dr. Skul and Dr. Hoyer have been among the "Best Doctors for Women in
Chicago," “Top Primary Care Doctors in Chicago,” and "Top Doctors in Chicago" as reported by Chicago
Magazine. They also continue to be named "The Nation's Top Doctors" by US News. They were also
ranked as Chicago Super Doctors, won the Super Service Award for Internal Medicine from Angie's
List, and have been selected as Castle Connolly's Exceptional Women in Medicine for 2019.

Call or book an appointment online with Comprehensive Center for Women’s Medicine today.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

### Optimal Healing Through Comprehensive Therapy is Close By

At Hands-On Health Massage & Physical Therapy, we provide a unique team approach to true healing,
pain control and stress relief. Our name says it all: we utilize a variety of hands-on therapy
methods, including relaxing massages, targeted exercises, and deep stretching with applied pressure
to treat muscle and joint problems and help your body heal properly. With many decades of combined
experience, our team of professionals are well trained in comprehensive hands-on physical therapy
and massage, and have been instrumental in helping thousands of people see remarkable improvement in
their mobility and pain reduction. We’d love to help you too. For more information on our massage
therapy and physical therapy services, call Hands-On Health Massage & Physical Therapy in High Point
today. A member of our team will be happy to explain our many services to see what might be just
right for you.

## Helpful Care Information Frequently Asked Questions

##### 1. What services does Healthpoint Homecare Services LLC provide?
* We offer a range of home health care services, including Chronic Disease Management, Medication
  Teaching and Management, Post-Surgical Care, Pain Management, and other individualized support to
  help clients recover and maintain health in the comfort of their own home.

##### 2. How do I schedule an assessment or start services?
* You can contact us by phone or email to request a free in-home assessment. Our team will guide you
  through the process, evaluate your needs, and create a personalized care plan.

##### 3. Is home health care covered by insurance?
* Coverage depends on your individual insurance plan. Please contact us to verify coverage. We
  accept a variety of insurance providers and can help you understand your benefits.

##### 4. Where do you provide services?
* We serve clients throughout Massachusetts, including Springfield and surrounding communities,
  delivering care in homes and approved locations.

##### 5. How are care plans developed?
* After an initial assessment, our clinical team designs a customized care plan that addresses your
  medical, emotional, and daily living needs. Plans are regularly updated to reflect changing needs.

##### 6. Who provides the care?
* Our skilled caregivers and licensed healthcare professionals are trained to deliver compassionate,
  consistent, and safe care, tailored to each client’s individual requirements.

## Wellness Support for Seniors Who Want to Feel Better and Live Fully

Getting older does not mean settling for less energy and confidence in your life. HealthySeventy
brings practical guidance, real resources, and personal care together so older adults can feel
stronger and think more clearly. If you are looking for solid health and wellness programs for aging
adults or a more personal senior wellness program in Montclair, NJ, this place was built for you.

## Built Around the Real Needs of Older Adults

Many wellness brands target seniors via ads, but HealthySeventy works with them closely. We offer
useful information, honest guidance, and practical support that make everyday life a little easier
to manage.

We care about how you feel, how well you move, and how your daily habits are holding up long term.
From helpful educational content to hands-on senior wellness support in Montclair, NJ, the goal is
simple. To help seniors live with more comfort, more confidence, and more independence.

## Our Wellness Services for Seniors

HealthySeventy looks at the full aging journey, not just one piece of it. Here is what we offer in
our health and wellness programs for aging adults:

### Mind and Body Wellness Support

HealthySeventy offers a senior wellness program in Montclair, NJ, designed to support the full aging
journey. Instead of focusing on a single aspect of senior health, we examine the habits and tools
that shape their everyday well-being.

### Mind Cleansing

Our mind-focused support helps older adults quiet the mental noise, reset their outlook, and build a
calmer daily rhythm. It is a core part of what makes our senior wellness support in Montclair, NJ,
different from a standard wellness clinic.

### Flexibility and Movement Support

When the body moves better, everything else gets easier. Our flexibility support helps seniors
improve range of motion, feel more comfortable day to day, and support the body's natural healing
over time.

### Medical Support and Supplies

Practical tools matter more to aging adults that most people realize. We help seniors access what
they need to feel safer, more comfortable, and more independent at home.

The Hypermobility Syndromes Association is here to support everyone with symptomatic hypermobility
to manage their condition well – whatever the cause, however mildly or severely they may be
affected, and whether or not they are diagnosed.

Hypermobility is:

Where joints bend further than average, and affects around 30% of the population. Around 10% of
these people live with symptoms which can range from mild to disabling, can affect many of the
body's systems (not just the joints), and vary over time. Find out more about [hypermobility and the
conditions which can cause it here][36]. Find out more about [living well with hypermobility
here][37].

[supportive hands.png]

###### How we can help

##### Our charity has a holistic, solution-focused approach to living well with a hypermobility
##### syndrome, our expert patients, volunteers, and clinical advisory board provide
##### management-focused patient support groups, and educational programs, information, and advice
##### to hypermobile people and their wider support network, including health and social care
##### professionals.

## About Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness

At Ignite Chiropractic & Wellness, our standard is simple: care for every patient like family. That
means no sales tactics, no gimmicks, and no hidden fees — just evidence-informed chiropractic care,
outstanding service, and full transparency every step of the way.

## Our Services

We offer a comprehensive suite of therapies designed to work in harmony, reducing inflammation and
restoring proper movement patterns for long-term health.



### Chiropractic Care

Optimal spinal function supports a more adaptable, efficient nervous system. By restoring proper
joint motion and reducing mechanical stress, we help your brain and body communicate more
effectively—allowing you to move better, recover faster, and function at your highest level.


### Class IV Laser Therapy

Experience advanced, non-invasive treatment designed to accelerate healing and reduce pain at the
cellular level. Our Aspen Class IV Laser increases circulation, decreases inflammation, and
stimulates tissue repair—helping you recover faster and get back to doing what you love.


### Massage Therapy

Our licensed therapists provide customized soft tissue care that complements chiropractic
adjustments, decreasing muscle tension and improving mobility.

## Raise your hand if the process of or shopping for home medical equipment makes you feel like

# **HOME CARE EQUIPMENT** *Experts at your service*

What if you could work with a home-grown company that has your loved ones’ best interests at heart?
Our goal – no matter what – is to make sure you walk away with the peace of mind that comes from
knowing you’ve purchased the best possible product to keep them happy, healthy, and safe.

## **Visit our showrooms**

It’s hard to shop online when you don’t know exactly what you’re looking for. We invite you to visit
one of our three showrooms to explore the possibilities!

## **Cut to the chase**

Our super-savvy team members can help you figure out the equipment that best meets your needs.
(Exhale. Frustrating Google searches are a thing of the past!)

## Feel good about your decision

You’ll feel a huge sense of relief when you buy the right equipment with confidence. (Knowing that
you’ve found the perfect way to protect and care for your loved one is priceless.)

# Walk out the door knowing you got it right

With two showrooms in Fort Wayne and one in Auburn, we invite you to stop in to see – or try! –
anything we have in stock. We’ll help you figure out the best solutions for your loved one,
providing the kind of honest insight and helpful tips you’d get from a lifelong friend.

Improve circulation, reduce swelling, and decrease the likelihood of venous disorders.

showed no adverse events-supporting CE Mark submission.

efficacy-proving a non-invasive way to ease late-pregnancy discomfort.

[Dr. Tan]

As the principal pain doctor in Singapore running The Pain Relief Clinic, Dr Terence Tan’s passion
for pain relief grew out of personal experience.

Having spent well over a decade treating patients suffering from pain, Dr Tan developed his special
interest by introducing non-invasive pain solutions and tissue repair technologies into Singapore.

He is accredited with both the Family Physician Accreditation Board and the Singapore Medical
Council.

He is also a member of the Singapore Medical Association and The Pain Association of Singapore.

Committed to providing result oriented pain treatments, his philosophy is to always offer patients
the safest, most effective and least invasive treatments available.

His patients appreciate the value of being able to have consultations, investigations (xray,
ultrasound and MRI), and treatments all done on the same day, especially when they are suffering
from severe pain.

Dr Tan’s clinical approach is that while there is a role for short term medications in specific
situations, patients do not generally want to be dependent on long term painkillers or try risky
solutions.

Even in age related, “wear and tear”, and other chronic conditions, a comprehensive yet targeted
approach to pain management can help patients be free from pain and lead a healthy active life.

## The Importance of Treating Pain Effectively:

Acute pain from recent injuries and other diseases can result in time off work, difficulty with
participation in sports, and interfere with other normal day activities.
Persistent pain from chronic injuries, wear and tear, nerve pain, and other causes often results in
frustration, low energy level, poor sleep (insomnia), irritability, depressed mood, difficulty with
concentration and memory, mobility problems and even reduced sexual function.
Relationships with friends and family, work, personal happiness and life in general may also be
affected. Pain has even been associated with loss of brain mass.

By properly treating persistent pain, patients will be able to enjoy work, sports, and life in
general more effectively.
Sleep will also become more restful, resulting in more energetic days and better moods.
